form_inputs.box_type: startup delivery generator and generated artifact contract
form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Generated startup artifacts must instruct AI to read tell_AI_read_before_all.md before opening any ZIP contents or maintenance file.
first_prompts_to_ai.zip must contain 000_READ_TELL_AI_READ_BEFORE_ALL_FIRST.md as the first ZIP entry.
prompt_library.zip must contain 000_READ_TELL_AI_READ_BEFORE_ALL_FIRST.md as the first ZIP entry.
tell_AI_read_before_all.md must start with the mandatory reading-order block.
zz_read_only_if_modifying_startup_delivery.md must start with the mandatory reading-order block and must remain maintenance-only.
Normal startup order is tell_AI_read_before_all.md, then first_prompts_to_ai.zip, then prompt_library.zip.
prompt_library.zip is opened only for a specific routed prompt_path, not during normal startup.
Do not restore paste_if_modify_startup_delivery.md as the active maintenance filename.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Preview Freeze Entry, then Confirm and Write after human review for Startup artifact read order guard.
form_inputs.validation_evidence_summary: Validation command: python validation\test_startup_artifact_read_order_guard_v1.py. Successful markers: VALIDATION OK: startup-artifact-read-order-guard-v1 and STATUS: IN_SYNC. Static and generated-artifact validation covers generator compile, startup sync, first_prompt_files sort order, tell_AI first read-order block, maintenance read-order block, first_prompts_to_ai.zip first-entry read-order guard, prompt_library.zip first-entry read-order guard, and absence of the retired active maintenance filename.
